build_BaseTransformer: build a BaseTransformer model using BaseTransformerArgs to configure dim, n_layers, n_heads, and max_seqlen
create_RotaryEmbedding: create a RotaryEmbedding module with theta, head_dim, and max_seqlen to precompute RoPE frequency tensors
run_Attention_forward: run the Attention module forward pass with rotary embeddings and optional GQA via n_kv_heads
test_FeedForward: test the FeedForward SwiGLU block with configurable hidden_dim, multiple_of, and ffn_dim_multiplier
review_generate_doc_mask_mod: review generate_doc_mask_mod to create document-aware attention masks for sequence-stacked batch inputs
